meta_description:
16K likes, 112 comments - prernachhabra on October 21, 2024: "A different #karwachauth than my previous ones coz for once I was totally unbothered about my outfit or getting “good pictures” clicked 😂

But still a truly wholesome one coz for the first time I wasn’t alone for the festivities.. had my mum ofcourse, then mother in law and FIL joined us all few days ago and a surprise but wonderful addition was my masi.
Here are few clicks with my masi 💕

As you grow older you realise festivals feel like festivals when you have your closed ones around ☺️😇

10 more days to go.. let’s see when the lil one decides to come 💕

#karwachauth #prernachhabra #stylinginspirations #pregnancydiaries #kc2024 #festivewear #kc #ethnicwear #festiveseason #indianwear #maternityfashion".
